description: This Python source file implements security-related functions for authentication, including password hashing, password verification, JWT token creation (access and refresh tokens), and token decoding. It leverages external libraries such as 'jose' for JWT handling and 'passlib' for password hashing, and it retrieves configuration settings from a centralized source.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt via passlib.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against its hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(data: dict[str, Any], expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token with optional expiration.

methods.name: str create_refresh_token(data: dict[str, Any], expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT refresh token with optional expiration, defaulting to longer duration than access token.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token and returns its payload if valid.
